# Shepherd of Hermas Chapter 101 — The EMET Bible (Literal)

**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Codex Athous, Shepherd of Hermas 101 | **Source Image:** source-texts/greek-EC/SHE_101_page_001.jpg

---

## Similitude 9, Chapter 18

**1** "Now I know, Lord," I said, "but I want to know further if those who have repented can still be placed into the tower." **2** "They can," he said, "if they repent and put away the works of these women, and the names of the good virgins are given back to them, and they themselves bear those names." **3** "And when," I said, "will those stones that were thrown aside be fitted in?" **4** "When they repent," he said. **5** "But if they do not repent quickly," he said, "they shall not enter the tower; only when the tower is finished can any enter." **6** "And will it be possible for them to repent, Lord?" I asked. **7** "It is indeed possible; but if the tower is completed and they have not yet repented, they shall no longer have a place in the building — for there is no more room." **8** "Lord," I said, "I want to ask you further." "Speak," he said. **9** "Will the repentant have a place in the tower if they repent, even if they were grievous sinners?" **10** "Yes," he said, "if they truly repent and cast off the works of wickedness, they can be built into the tower; but not in the prominent places — they shall be placed in the lower and inferior positions. But they shall be built into the tower if they repent now, before it is completed." **11** "And if any repent after the tower is complete?" "They shall be rejected from the tower — only the Lord knows if any of these repentant sinners can enter the kingdom of God." **12** "But if we hear of this from you first, Lord, we will have repented before the tower is completed." He laughed and said to me, "You are very glad about it, and you spoke the truth."

---

*EMET: the gradations of placement in the tower (prominent vs. lower/inferior) are a striking insight — full repentance brings entry but not equivalence of position. The completion deadline is absolute.*
